sar_reference.narrative: On or about 2016-12-20, financial institution investigation identified unauthorized transactional activity impacting customer C13171 on payment card C13171-K2. Flagged transaction 3558054 totaling $55.68 was executed under patterns characteristic of PatternEnum.CARD_NOT_PRESENT_FRAUD. Graph traversal analysis identified connections across account profiles and device entities (DEV_f89aeb1d49ce1035), involving an aggregate suspicious exposure of $55.68. Cardholder inquiry verified the activity was unauthorized. The institution has blocked card C13171-K2, placed linked cards under protective monitoring, and submitted this Suspicious Activity Report pursuant to FinCEN guidelines and Bank Fraud Policy R2/R6.
